newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Several dealers cut prices.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Several dealers cut prices.

text.p: U.S. millfeed dealers reported steady to lower prices at several locations in reaction to easing demand as green pastures have lessened the need for feed, dealers said.

However, prices increased at a few locations in anticipation of production cutbacks at flour mills. Dealers from Buffalo to Portland reported 4-1/2- to five-day flour mill runs scheduled next week versus a normal six days.
"They made all their cookies for Easter and now they are cutting back," said a Chattanooga dealer of the flour mills.
Dealers said the cutbacks in flour production should not create millfeed shortages because demand from feed mixers was light.
In the southeast, dealers said recent 70-degree Fahrenheit weather has spurred pasture growth, lessening the demand for feed.
